notes: Approvals redesigned: each workflow is one card — who and what, then who approves — and a group can have several (rush orders to one person, large quantities to another), with new conditions (card or account, ship-to state/country, cost center, large single items, print on demand, short items, PO text, role) and a Test an order panel. Card groups can hold the card at checkout and charge it when approved. A SKU can now need more time than the SLA (Ships within): orders containing it ship later and can't be rushed. Fixed: rush windows and the order cutoff followed the server's clock — set your warehouse time zone under Settings → Shipping.
